OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'

        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone

      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'

          properties:

              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:

      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name

## Summary

I implemented optional owner email with duplicate-rejection semantics.

**Behavior:** when a request includes `email`, it's stored and returned as `email` on the owner response; if that email is already used by another owner, creation is rejected with **409 Conflict**. When no email is given, creation proceeds as before.

**Changes:**
- **`openapi.yml`** — added an optional `email` property (`format: email`, max 255) to `OwnerFields`, so the generated `OwnerFieldsDto`/`OwnerDto` carry it and MapStruct maps it automatically both ways.
- **`model/Owner.java`** — added the `email` field (`@Column(name = "email")`) with getter/setter.
- **`service/ClinicServiceImpl.saveOwner`** — on create, after the existing telephone-uniqueness check, reject with `DuplicateOwnerException` when a non-blank email matches an existing owner's email.
- **`service/DuplicateOwnerException`** — added a message constructor so the email conflict surfaces an email-specific message (the existing 409 handler in `ExceptionControllerAdvice` renders it).
- **Schemas** (`db/{h2,hsqldb,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`) — added the `email` column to `owners`.
- **Seed data** (`db/hsqldb/data.sql`, `db/mysql/data.sql`) — the positional `INSERT INTO owners VALUES (...)` statements would break with the new column, so I made them explicit-column inserts. (h2/postgres already used explicit columns.)
- **Tests** (`OwnerRestControllerV1Tests`) — added `createOwnerWithEmailReturnsEmail` (email echoed back on 201) and `createOwnerDuplicateEmailConflict` (reused email → 409).

The test DB is HSQLDB (per `src/test/resources/application.properties`), which is why the seed-data fix was required for the suite to run.
